description:
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the clinical team at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This is an exceptional opportunity for a visionary nursing leader to oversee all nursing operations, ensure the highest standards of patient care, and foster a supportive environment for both residents and staff.

As the Director of Nursing, you will play a critical role in shaping the quality of care provided, managing nursing staff, and ensuring compliance with all regulatory standards. We offer a competitive annual salary range of $85,000 to $95,000, reflecting your expertise and dedication to excellence in long-term care.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Iowa.
Minimum of 2-3 years of experience as a Director of Nursing or in a similar nursing leadership role.
Proven experience in a skilled nursing or long-term care setting.
Strong knowledge of state and federal regulations for skilled nursing facilities.
Demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, and manage a diverse nursing team.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $85,000 to $95,000, commensurate with experience.
